scripts.dev: npm run sync && cd site && node ../scripts/run-mint.mjs dev
scripts.validate: npm run sync && cd site && node ../scripts/run-mint.mjs validate
scripts.broken-links: npm run sync && cd site && node ../scripts/run-mint.mjs broken-links
scripts.build: npm run sync && node scripts/prepare-export.mjs && cd site && node ../scripts/run-mint.mjs export --output ../dist/site-export.zip
